notes.subject: ⟨את⟩ ×2
notes.rationale: Translation accidently inserted aleph-tav markers; Hebrew verse 15 has none — corrected reading: 'Na ol i no painim ol meri bilipela olsem ol pikinini meri bilong Iyob long olgeta graun, na papa bilong ol i givim long ol ol samting bilong papa i givim long taim dai, namel long ol brata bilong ol.'

notes.subject: inheritance for daughters
notes.rationale: Daughters inheriting alongside brothers is exceptional in Torah custom (cf. Num 27) — some read it as sign of Job's restored extraordinary blessing.

translation: Na ol i no painim ol meri olsem bilipela olsem ol pikinini meri bilong Iyob long olgeta graun, na papa bilong ol i givim ⟨את⟩ olgeta ⟨את⟩ ol samting bilong ol papa i givim long taim dai, namel long ol brata bilong ol.
